Sketchbook of ongoing investigation; tracks artists studied, media tested, contextual research and self-evaluation; not directly assessed but underpins PP.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Process Portfolio (HL Extension) — a core area of Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Process Portfolio (HL Extension) brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Process Portfolio (HL Extension).

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
